bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
echo MOUNT_ENTRY
findmnt -T /mnt/g -no SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true
echo SYS_MOUNT_LINE
grep ' /mnt/g ' /proc/mounts | head -3 || true
echo PRIVILEGE
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null;then echo PASSWORDLESS_SUDO=YES;else echo PASSWORDLESS_SUDO=NO;fi
echo MOUNTPOINT_ENTRY
stat -L /mnt/g 2>&1 | head -6 || true
echo MOUNT_DEFINITIONS
grep -R -n -E 'GserverStorage|mount -t drvfs|/mnt/g' /etc/fstab /etc/wsl.conf 2>/dev/null | head -25 || true
echo MOUNT_USERS
if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1;then timeout 5s fuser -m /mnt/g 2>&1 | head -8 || true;fi
echo WINDOWS_DRIVE_QUERY
if test -x /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe;then timeout 8s /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe /c 'if exist G:\GserverStorage\ (echo WINDOWS_G_EXISTS) else (echo WINDOWS_G_MISSING)' 2>&1 | head -6; else echo WINDOWS_CMD_INTEROP_NOT_ACCESSIBLE;fi
echo USERBOT
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo END
